d: A helicopter carrying six people, including five passengers from Bengaluru and one pilot, reportedly crashed in Uttarakhand while flying from Badrinath to Dehradun on Friday. All six on board were killed in the crash. The Trans Bharat helicopter took off from Badrinath at 1.14 pm and lost contact with its tracking system while crossing Joshimath Valley. Information about a reported crash landing near Chai village was received at 2.21 pm, following which SDRF teams from Joshimath and Pandukeshwar were dispatched.
